identity.title: List of Japanese language original series home video releases

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters.

==VHS Rentals==
Pocket Monsters for rental VHS is divided into four sets that were released by and Shogakukan. It contains almost all of the 276 episodes between them.
===Pocket Monsters===

Pocket Monsters was released on VHS for rent by and Shogakukan between 1997 and 1999. It consists of 27 volumes with 80 episodes across them combined.

Rougela's Christmas was released separately. It is included on a VHS along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Summer Vacation.
 
===Pocket Monsters Episode: Orange Islands===

Pocket Monsters Episode: Orange Islands was released on VHS for rent by and Shogakukan between 1999 and 2000. It consists of 12 volumes with 35 episodes across them combined.

Pikachu VS Nyarth!? was released separately. It is included on a VHS along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Rescue Adventure.
 
===Pocket Monsters Episode: Gold & Silver===

Pocket Monsters Episode: Gold & Silver was released on VHS for rent by and Shogakukan between 2000 and 2002. It consists of 36 volumes with 109 episodes across them combined.

Ringuma Shock!! and Where's Kakureon!? Huge Chaos Created By the Invisible Pokémon! were released separately. The former is included along with the Pikachu short Pichu and Pikachu, and the latter is included along with Pikachu's Exciting Hide-and-seek, both available on VHS and DVD.
 
===Pocket Monsters: Gold and Silver Edition 2002===

Pocket Monsters: Gold and Silver Edition 2002 was released on VHS for rent by and Shogakukan between 2002 and 2003. It consists of 15 volumes with 46 episodes across them combined.

Pupurin Twins VS Purin! Singing Pokémon Concert! was released separately. It is included with the Pikachu short Pikapika Starry Sky Camp on both VHS and DVD.
 

==Home Releases==
Pocket Monsters for home video is divided into three sets that were released by and Shogakukan. It contains almost all of Pocket Monsters and Pocket Monsters Episode: Orange Islands, but only the first twenty episodes of Pocket Monsters: Gold and Silver.
===Pocket Monsters===

Pocket Monsters was released on VHS by and Shogakukan between 1998 and 1999. It consists of 40 volumes with 80 episodes across them combined.

Rougela's Christmas was released separately. It is included on a VHS along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Summer Vacation.
 
===Pocket Monsters: The Orange Islands Edition===

Pocket Monsters: The Orange Islands Edition was released on VHS by and Shogakukan in 2000. It consists of 9 volumes with 35 episodes across them combined.

Pikachu VS Nyarth!? was released separately. It is included on a VHS along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Rescue Adventure.
 
===Pocket Monsters: Gold and Silver Edition===
Pocket Monsters: Gold and Silver Edition was released on VHS and DVD by and Shogakukan in 2001. It consists of 5 volumes with 20 episodes across them combined. The DVD releases include bonus content.
 

==External links==
Official Japanese site (archive)
